newsitem.title: USA: Rayonier Timberlands sets lower Q2 payout.
newsitem.headline: Rayonier Timberlands sets lower Q2 payout.

text.p: Rayonier Timberlands LP said on Friday it declared a lower second quarter distribution of $1.24 per class A unit, payable June 30 to unit holders of record May 30.
A portion of this distribution represents return of capital, depending on each unitholder's tax basis.

Rayonier Forest Resources Co, the managing general partner of Rayonier Timberlands, said when it announced the previous distribution for March 1997 of $1.70 that it expected partnership results for 1997 to be lower than in 1996 and that distributions related to 1997 results would total less than distributions related to 1996 results.
Rayonier Timberlands, LP grows and sells timber in the United States.
